# White Forest Homes

White Forest Homes is a residential construction company based in Huntsville, Ontario, serving Muskoka and surrounding communities.

Primary services:
- Custom home construction
- Renovations and additions
- Custom kitchens and interior renovations
- Decks and outdoor living improvements
- Framing, flooring, bathroom remodelling, windows, doors and fences
